title: 第346章 自废丹田
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

听到裴云虎之言，灰袍老者虽然依旧没松口，但眼中亮起的精芒明显在告诉世人，他确实心动了。

赵家一共就二十五名筑基强者，这次来了十五人，若是尽数折损在此地，势必会一落千丈。

而他裴家虽然也折损了四人之多，但抛开这四人后，也还有十三名筑基强者。

这么一对比起来，裴家的筑基强者数量，岂不反超了赵家？

“嘶！二叔，你快看！”就在这时，灰袍老者耳边，忽然响起裴云虎的惊叫声。

灰袍老者回过神向下一看，也愣了一下。

只见，结界中央的韩林，忽然一甩衣袖，一根阴气森森的骨刺狠狠打在了结界之上。

让看似牢不可破的结界，突然光芒一暗。

“韩云双煞！”

“他就是那个姓韩的狗贼！”

见到这根骨刺，赵家众人齐齐一愣，然后爆发出强烈的恨意。

他就是勒索赵家五百万的韩云双煞？

其余众人闻言，也一阵愕然，大感不可思议起来。

这家伙可真是狂的没边啊，都被全世界通缉了，竟然还敢跳出来招惹赵家这尊巨无霸。

“哈哈哈，韩贼，天堂有路你不走，地狱无门你闯进来！今日我看你往哪里跑。”

赵秉谦错愕了一下后，脸上露出浓浓的惊喜。

“跑？谁说我要跑了。”

韩林冷笑一声，原本僵持在结界上的骨刺，忽然爆发出一阵璀璨的辉芒。

接着就在众人目瞪口呆的表情下“嘭”的一声，直接将一面结界刺得爆裂开来。

然后身形一晃，人就已经飞到了囚笼的外面，接着随手一抛，百鬼仙图呼的一下在几名赵家强者头顶展开。

伴着一大片阴云垂落而下，无数鬼灵瞬间汹涌而出，向着几人体内钻了进去。

赵秉谦等人面色大变，纷纷抬手攻向韩林，却被韩林轻松躲过，然后驱动骨刺法器冲进阴云之中，噗噗几声，直接将还未回过神的三名筑基强者穿胸而过。

接着右手一挥，百鬼仙图直接调转方向，朝赵秉谦等人飞来，但被几人躲了过去。

韩林并不失望，辗转腾挪间来到一名筑基中期的中年男子身后，唰的一剑，就将其脑袋斩了下来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After hearing Pei Yunhu's words, although the old man in gray robe still didn't let go, the sparkle in his eyes clearly told the world that he was indeed moved.

There are a total of twenty-five foundation-building experts in the Zhao family. Fifteen of them came this time. If they were all lost here, they would surely plummet.

Although his Pei family also lost four people, after leaving these four people aside, there are still thirteen strong foundation builders.

Comparing this, doesn't the number of foundation-building experts of the Pei family surpass that of the Zhao family?

"Hiss! Second uncle, look!" At this moment, Pei Yunhu's scream suddenly sounded in the ears of the old man in gray robe.

The old man in gray robe came back to his senses and looked down, and was stunned for a moment.

Han Lin, who was in the center of the barrier, suddenly flicked his sleeve, and a gloomy bone spur hit the barrier hard.

The seemingly unbreakable barrier suddenly dimmed.

"Han Yun Shuangsha!"

"He is the dog thief named Han!"

Seeing this bone spur, everyone in the Zhao family was stunned, and then burst into intense hatred.

Is he the Han Yun Shuangsha who extorted five million from the Zhao family?

When the rest of the people heard this, they were also stunned and felt incredible.

This guy is really crazy. He is wanted all over the world, and he still dares to jump out and provoke the Zhao family.

"Hahaha, Han thief, there is a road to heaven but you don't take it. Hell has no door and you break in! Today I will see where you run."

Zhao Bingqian was stunned for a moment, then his face showed deep surprise.

"Run? Who said I was going to run away."

Han Lin sneered, and the bone spurs that were originally stuck on the barrier suddenly burst out with a bright light.

Then, under the stunned expressions of everyone, there was a "bang" sound, which directly stabbed one side of the barrier and exploded.

Then with a flash of body, the person flew outside the cage, and then with a casual throw, the Hundred Ghosts Immortal Picture spread out over the heads of several strong men of the Zhao family.

As a large cloud fell, countless ghosts surged out instantly and penetrated into the bodies of several people.

The expressions of Zhao Bingqian and others changed greatly, and they all raised their hands to attack Han Lin, but Han Lin easily dodged it, and then drove the bone spur weapon into the clouds. With a few puffs, he directly pierced the chest of the three foundation-building experts who had not yet recovered.

Then with a wave of his right hand, the Hundred Ghost Immortal Picture changed its direction and flew towards Zhao Bingqian and others, but was dodged by several people.

Han Lin was not disappointed. He walked around and came to a middle-aged man in the middle stage of foundation building, and cut off his head with a sharp sword.
